segments.on_screen_text: 4 days in COLORADO ASPEN & VAIL
segments.description: Intro montage showcasing highlight clips of Colorado travel trip.

segments.on_screen_text: A little getaway for the long weekend Going somewhere I've never been before
segments.description: View from an airplane window looking down at the runway before takeoff.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 1 Perfect first meal after landing
segments.description: Shots inside an In-N-Out restaurant showing food service and table with burgers and fries.
Vlogger sitting at In-N-Out eating a burger.

segments.on_screen_text: A three and a half drive to aspen The view made it worth it
segments.description: Scenic driving montage along mountain roads on the way to Aspen.

segments.on_screen_text: FRENCH ALPINE BISTRO
segments.description: Exterior shot of French Alpine Bistro lit with christmas lights.

segments.on_screen_text: Made an early dinner res as soon as we arrived Fell in love with the cozy vibes immediately
segments.description: Interior shots of the cozy, dimly lit French Alpine Bistro restaurant.

segments.on_screen_text: The French onion soup was perfect for the frigid weather Cheersing to being reunited and our first night together!
segments.description: Vlogger and friends dining at the bistro, eating soup and clinking wine glasses.

segments.on_screen_text: Everything was delicious, fondue is a must when you visit!
segments.description: Close-up shots of cheese fondue boiling in a pot at the table.
Vlogger dipping bread into fondue and eating it.

segments.on_screen_text: Can't forget dessert
segments.description: Group sharing a dessert crepe plate at the restaurant table.
Girls sitting outside by a fire pit and walking down nighttime illuminated streets.
Vlogger walking down Aspen street at night talking to the camera.

segments.on_screen_text: Living Room AT HOTEL JEROME This place was packed
segments.description: Exterior of Hotel Jerome and interior shots of the busy Living Room lounge.

segments.on_screen_text: So good to be reunited with friends I hadn't seen in over a year Us trying to rally but we ended up going home soon afterwards haha
segments.description: Friends sitting at a cocktail table doing shots together.

segments.on_screen_text: KEMOSABE BE PREPARED TO SPEND Stopped by this famous shop before checking into our airbnb
segments.description: Exterior and interior clips inside Kemo Sabe hat store as girls try on fur gloves.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 2
segments.description: Vlogger lying in bed talking about Day 2 morning plans in Aspen.
Vlogger walking onto snowy balcony in pajamas and enjoying the view.
Outfit of the day (GRWM) segment showing winter clothes, hat, and accessories.
Scenic car drive shots showing snowy mountains and trees.

segments.on_screen_text: WHITE HOUSE TAVERN
segments.description: Interior of White House Tavern restaurant and food dishes on the table.

segments.on_screen_text: This was one of my favorite meals The sandwich was so good!!
segments.description: Vlogger sitting in booth eating a crispy chicken sandwich.
POV shot walking outside on snow.
Vlogger walking outside talking to camera about lunch and heading to Little Nell.
Scenic view of ski slopes and snowy streets in Aspen during daytime.
Vlogger in clothing boutique trying on fur hoods and vests in front of mirror.

segments.on_screen_text: Came back to Kemo Sabe Loved this coat and came back to try it on
segments.description: Vlogger back inside Kemo Sabe shop watching hat shaping and trying on coats.

segments.on_screen_text: Warming up at the Little Nell got their famous hot chocolate
segments.description: Close-up of hot chocolate with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

segments.on_screen_text: 6/10 a bit overpriced but a nice little break for the day
segments.description: Vlogger drinking the hot chocolate at Little Nell.

segments.on_screen_text: Met up with our friends who finished snowboarding
segments.description: Outdoor patio at Ajax Tavern showing friends sipping Veuve Clicquot champagne.

segments.on_screen_text: CASA TUA Early dinner at Casa Tua before driving to Vail
segments.description: Interior of Casa Tua restaurant and sequence of delicious Italian dishes.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 3 Fiancé braided my hair hehe
segments.description: Vlogger showing off braided hair done by her fiancé.

segments.on_screen_text: Picking up our ski rentals
segments.description: Vlogger entering ski rental shop, getting boots fitted, and putting them on.
Vlogger walking in ski gear in Vail talking about taking her first ski lesson in 15 years.
Montage of ski lesson, riding chairlifts, and practicing skiing down slope.

segments.on_screen_text: After a full day of skiing joined some other friends for dinner
segments.description: Friends clinking red wine glasses and eating dinner at restaurant table.

segments.on_screen_text: Every night we ended with an intense couple rounds of monopoly deal :)
segments.description: Playing Monopoly Deal card game on the floor.

segments.on_screen_text: Late night shin ramyun
segments.description: Pot of boiling Shin Ramyun instant noodles.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 4
segments.description: GRWM sequence doing makeup and putting on ski layers.
Inside The Little Diner restaurant with breakfast burritos and coffee.

segments.on_screen_text: Attempting to ski with my friends today Second day of skiing feeling a bit more confident
segments.description: Gondola ride and montage of day 2 skiing down Vail slopes.

segments.on_screen_text: Walking over to meet up with my friends First ever ski shot I was scared lol Thank you for watching!
segments.description: Group at Red Lion taking a ski shot together and eating chicken wings.

segments.on_screen_text: Follow me on Instagram @Loisjyou
segments.description: Outro card with Instagram call to action.

hook.opening_visual: Title overlay '4 days in COLORADO ASPEN & VAIL' over panoramic mountain landscape view.
hook.notes: Fast-paced aesthetic highlight reel previewing the 4-day trip to Aspen and Vail.
